source:
Build telekinetic power and dump it into an adjacent creature or yourself.
		This will launch them to a targeted location in radius %d.

		Launched enemies take %0.1f Physical damage and are stunned for %d turns upon landing.
		When the target lands, creatures within radius 2 take %0.1f Physical damage and are knocked away from you.
		This talent ignores %d%% of the knockback resistance of the thrown target, which takes half damage if it resists being thrown.

		When used on yourself, you will launch in a straight line, knocking enemies flying and doing %0.1f Physical damage to each.
		You can break through %d walls while doing this.
		The damage and range increases with Mindpower.
surface_observation: 原文可对相邻生物使用，译文缩为相邻敌人；对自身使用时，原文击飞沿途敌人，译文扩大为所有目标。
target:
使用你的念动力增强你的力量，使你能够举起一个相邻的敌人或者你自己并投掷到半径 %d 范围的任意位置。
		敌人落地时受到 %0.1f 物理伤害，并被震慑 %d 回合。落点周边半径 2 格内的所有其他单位受到 %0.1f 物理伤害，并被击退至远离你的位置。
		这个技能无视被投掷目标 %d%% 的击退抵抗，如果目标抵抗击退，只受到一半伤害。

		对你自己使用时，击退线路上所有目标并造成 %0.1f 物理伤害。
		同时能破坏至多 %d 面墙壁。
		伤害和投掷距离受精神强度加成。

deep_observation: 语义错误："harassed" 被译为"陷入疲倦"，与该状态的实际含义无关。补查 tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/timed_effects/mental.lua（固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob ab3053c71d43a95cf631fcf5979ddcacb57a6b00）第 681-689 行：newEffect{ name = "HARASSED", image = "talents/harass_prey.png", desc = _t"Harassed" ... long_desc = ... "The target has been harassed by its stalker, reducing damage by %d%%." ... subtype = { fear=true }, status = "detrimental"，activate 中 addTemporaryValue("inc_damage", {all=eff.damageChange})。该状态是被跟踪者（stalker）骚扰导致伤害下降的恐惧类负面效果，来源图标即 harass_prey；"疲倦"既非骚扰语义，也不对应任何疲劳/耐力机制，玩家无法据此关联到 Harassed 状态及其配套提示 "+Harassed"/"#Target# is no longer harassed."（同文件 690 行）。
surface_observation: has been harassed 表示受到骚扰，译文“陷入疲倦”改变了状态含义。

source: It's made from mucus and it's oozing.

I followed the trail of bodies that you left - very impressive! We are lucky to have you on our side.
But enough talk; take this message. I must go now.

deep_observation: 机制漏译：原文 "a putrescent swirling cloud of radius %d that follows you around" 中的 "follows you around"（云雾持续跟随施法者移动）在译文中完全缺失，译文"在身边创造出半径 %d 码的腐败云雾"只交代生成位置，读起来是固定在原地的云雾。补查 tome 组件 game/modules/tome/data/talents/spells/master-of-flesh.lua（固定 commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，blob 54b9e74df3dcd3f6029fbe956151fa53486f4635）：info 文本在第 382 行；activate 在第 353-373 行调用 game.level.map:addEffect(self, self.x, self.y, ...)，其 update 回调为 function(e) if e.src.dead then return end e.x = e.src.x e.y = e.src.y e.duration = 10 return true end，即每次更新把效果坐标同步到施法者当前坐标，证实云雾确实随人移动，是该持续技能的关键机制。附带：同批次半径单位不一致，本条用"半径 %d 码"，而 revision 70f711c6（kinetic-mastery.lua "creatures within radius 2"）用"半径 2 格"。
source:
Shattering up to %d ghouls or ghasts you create a putrescent swirling cloud of radius %d that follows you around for 3 turns per dead ghoul plus one turn. Oldest ghouls are prioritized for destruction.
		Any ghoul or ghast dying or expiring within this cloud increases its duration by %d turn and every two absorbed ghoul/ghast your gain back one soul.
		The cloud deals %0.2f frostdusk damage to any foes caught inside.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
surface_observation: 原文明确云雾会跟随施术者移动，并将食尸鬼或妖鬼持续时间结束（expiring）纳入延长云雾的条件；译文只说在身边创造云雾、在云雾中死去，遗漏这两点。
target:
你粉碎最多 %d 个食尸鬼或妖鬼，在身边创造出半径 %d 码的腐败云雾，持续时间为杀死的食尸鬼数量乘 3 再加一回合。你会优先选择最老的食尸鬼。
		每个在云雾中死去的食尸鬼或妖鬼会增加它的持续时间 %d 回合，每死亡2个食尸鬼或妖鬼会恢复1点灵魂。
		云雾会对其中的所有敌人造成 %0.2f 霜暮伤害。
		伤害受法术强度加成。
